personality_one_liner: A sleek, premium, and distraction-free mobile booking experience where the cars and the Moroccan landscape take center stage.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-style margins. Let content breathe. Padding must be intentional and generous around cards and content edges.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers when scrolling over images or lists.
Use glass on the sticky bottom CTA bar on the Car Details screen.
dont's: Do not use glass for generic list rows or chips.
Do not use glass if it obscures primary reading text.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium entry point to explore car categories and featured rentals in Moroccan cities.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner over white background.
states.error: Unable to load featured inventory. Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable. Top area: large safe-area padded header with a subtle Hero featured card (using hero_bg image with top-to-bottom gradient scrim). Below hero: 'Select City' horizontal pill-shaped chips (Agadir, Casablanca, etc.). Next section: Category horizontal scroll (Economy, Luxury, SUV). Next: 'Featured Cars' multi-column or horizontal swipeable cards showcasing the car image, name, seats, transmission, and daily rate in EUR.

screens.name: Car Listing
screens.purpose: Detailed browsing and filtering of available cars.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the card shapes.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty road, 'No cars match your filters', and a 'Clear Filters' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load inventory. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontal filter chips (Category, Transmission, Fuel, Price). Below: Single-column vertically stacked cards. Each card spans full width (minus lg margins), featuring a prominent car photo (with scrim), title, specs ribbon (icons for seats, fuel, transmission), and price per day. The card behaves as a pressable leading to details.

screens.name: Car Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific car's specs with an immediate path to book or contact via WhatsApp.

states.loading: Full screen skeleton with image placeholder.
states.error: Failed to load car details. Retry button.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge image carousel at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim for back button contrast. Content below: Car Title, Category pill, Price. A structured grid for specifications (Seats, Fuel, Transmission). 'Available Cities' section. Description text. Sticky glass bottom bar containing 'Book Now' primary CTA alongside a secondary 'Contact WhatsApp' icon button.

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Frictionless checkout capturing dates, city, and user details.

states.error: Unable to complete booking. Please check details.

screens.layout: Single scroll vertical stacking. Section 1: Prominent Date range selector. Section 2: Pickup City selector. Section 3: User Details (Name, Email, Phone inputs). Bottom: Concise trip summary card (Rate x Days) and a Sticky Primary CTA 'Confirm Booking'.

screens.name: My Bookings
screens.purpose: Local storage-based list of the user's booking history.

states.empty: Icon of keys/car + 'You have no bookings yet. Start exploring.' + CTA.

screens.layout: Simple list of booking cards. Each card displays the Booking Reference, Car Name, Dates, and a status badge (e.g., 'Confirmed').

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Clean list rows. Prominent Language Switcher (FR/EN/AR) using segmented control or bottom sheet. Note: Arabic selection must trigger RTL layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Arabic language selection must support React Native's I18nManager.forceRTL(true) and mirror the layouts correctly.
Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality tightly: highly readable, generous padding, un-cluttered interface.
Colors: Strictly adhere to the monochrome charcoal/white palette to exude luxury and cleanness. Do not introduce blues or indigos.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans. Rely on sizing (sm to 2xl) and keep font-weight at 400 or 500 max. DO NOT use bold (700).
Images MUST use a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (Layer 1) before overlaying text (Layer 2) to guarantee contrast.
WhatsApp Contact on the Car Details screen should be prominent but distinct from the primary 'Book Now' checkout flow.
Store bookings via AsyncStorage (since no user auth exists yet) to populate the 'My Bookings' screen.
